Management Plan

- Clinical impression: Probable self-limiting viral upper respiratory infection.
- Provided advice:
  • Rest, adequate hydration, regular paracetamol for symptom relief  
  • Consider taking 1–2 days off work; reassess ability to return next week  
  • Reduce alcohol: trial reduction to ≤2 glasses/week, then taper further, in context of diabetes and hypertension
- Safety-netting:
  • Return in 2–3 days if no improvement or sooner if fever persists, cough worsens, or breathing becomes difficult  
  • Possible antibiotics if bacterial infection suspected at review
- Chronic disease care: Continue Metformin and Lisinopril; routine diabetes and BP follow-up with regular doctor.
- No immediate investigations or referrals arranged during this consult.
